prompt.project_info: Photorealistic 9:16 alpine twilight selfie-style portrait in a cedar soaking tub while snow falls.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with a heart-shaped face, icy blue-green eyes, wet-look black hair, light olive sun-kissed skin with visible pores and freckles, wearing a light-blue micro-ribbed scoop-neck one-piece swimsuit with supplied border mark. No jewelry.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated in a circular cedar soaking tub with lower body submerged, both arms resting over the tub border, closed-mouth smile and direct eye contact. Include a white fox nearby, snowy mountains, conifers, chalets and warm windows; preserve realistic water refraction, ripples, steam and condensation.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Diffuse cool civil-twilight ambient light with soft warm chalet glow fill, wet-skin and wet-hair highlights, active snowfall and snowy alpine atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 8K RAW aesthetic, 24mm wide-angle selfie simulation, f/2.2, 9:16, realistic water reflections, natural skin texture and no beauty smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 9:16 alpine twilight selfie-style portrait of one original approved adult woman with a heart-shaped face, icy blue-green eyes, wet-look black hair, light olive sun-kissed skin with visible pores and freckles. She wears a light-blue micro-ribbed scoop-neck one-piece swimsuit with the supplied small border mark and no jewelry. She sits in a circular cedar soaking tub with her lower body submerged, both arms resting over the tub border, a closed-mouth smile and direct eye contact. A white fox sits nearby, with snowy mountain peaks, snow-laden conifers and wooden chalets with warm tungsten windows in the background. Preserve water refraction, surface ripples, steam and condensation on the tub rim. Use diffuse cool civil-twilight ambient light with soft warm chalet glow fill, wet-skin and hair highlights, active snowfall, 24mm wide-angle selfie simulation at f/2.2, photorealistic 8K RAW detail and no beauty smoothing.
